title: WPSS/904/2015 of Dinesh Chandra Pandey Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
MCC No.802 of 2015
CLMA No.13605 of 2015
CLMA No. 12401 of 2016
IN
WPSS No. 904 of 2015
Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Mr. B.D. Pande, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. N.P. Sah, Standing Counsel for the
State/respondents.
This writ petition was dismissed for non-prosecution on 12.10.2015.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has
moved Delay Condonation application along with
Restoration application and has prayed that delay
in filing restoration application may be condoned.
Grounds shown in the affidavit are
sufficient and bona fide to condone the delay in
filing the restoration application. The Delay
Condonation application is allowed. Delay is
condoned.
Heard on the Restoration application.
The restoration application is allowed on
the grounds urged. Order dated 12.10.2015
passed by this Court is hereby recalled. The writ
petition is restored to its original number.
Learned counsel appearing for the
petitioner now seeks permission to withdraw the
present writ petition with liberty to file a fresh
writ petition.
An application for withdrawal has also
been filed by the petitioner to this effect.
In view of the statement made by learned
counsel for the petitioner, the writ petition is
dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to file a fresh
petition, in case occasion so arises.
Withdrawal application stands disposed
accordingly.
